[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested several tea flavors: Rooibos Chai, Genmaicha, Rose Chai, Lemon Ginger, Tie Guan Yin, Chrysanthemum Oolong, Peach Oolong, Saffron Tea, Yuzu Ginger, and White Peony.  
[USER] User expressed interest in trying Rooibos Chai and mentioned they are trying to cut down on caffeine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided information about Rooibos Chai, including its caffeine-free nature and health benefits: antioxidant-rich, calming and soothing, and digestive benefits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided preparation steps for Rooibos Chai: use 1-2 teaspoons of tea, heat water to 200°F (93°C) to 212°F (100°C), steep for 5-7 minutes, strain, and enjoy.
